# anthropic_workspace_service_accounts (Data Source)

Lists the service accounts that are members of a workspace. Requires `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_workspace_service_accounts" "production" {
  workspace_id = "wrkspc_01ExampleWorkspaceId000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace id (`wrkspc_...`).

### Read-Only

- `service_accounts` (Attributes List) Service-account memberships. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--service_accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_accounts`

Read-Only:

- `created_by_actor_id` (String) Actor that created the membership; null when implicit.
- `implicit` (Boolean) True for the implicit default-workspace membership.
- `service_account_id` (String) Service account id.
- `workspace_role` (String) Workspace role.
